# connects to

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:connectsTo`](gmeow-connectsTo.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/connectsTo>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)

Universal traversable-link relation: relates any GMEOW thing to another thing it is directly connected to in a graph, network, or path. Intentionally broad; use specialized subproperties ([`spatiallyConnectsTo`](gmeow-spatiallyConnectsTo.md), [`hasSpouse`](gmeow-hasSpouse.md), citesWork, dependsOn, …) when the kind of connection matters. NOT symmetric and NOT transitive at this level so that subproperties can be directed or undirected and reachability can be computed by the solver layer ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:connectsTo`](gmeow-connectsTo.md) when the definition matches the source fact. Prefer a narrower GMEOW term when one exists, and keep projection concerns in the mapping layer.
